1.why: Clean sans-serif typography with adequate line height and spacing is used throughout the interface.

2.why: Text formatting avoids italics and dense paragraphs, relying on short standard text blocks.

3.why: The single-column layout remains well-structured and readable for small display areas.

4.why: Interface labels and step prompts use direct, simple phrasing.

5.why: Form fields lack placeholder examples or visual input formatting guidance.

6.why: Screens present brief instructions rather than extended descriptive text.

7.why: No dedicated copy buttons are provided alongside the displayed manual secrets and recovery codes.

8.why: Authenticator setup relies entirely on text strings without providing a QR code option.

9.why: Standard form fields appear used, though explicit password manager integration cues are not shown.

10.why: Prominent blue call-to-action buttons clearly highlight the primary step action.

11.why: Each page focuses on a single task with one main interactive button.

12.why: Heading changes indicate progression, but detailed status feedback between steps is minimal.

13.why: Users can re-trigger code generation, but options to toggle visibility are absent.

14.why: The top alert uses neutral language, though it offers only generic guidance.

15.why: No active countdown timers or visible session timeouts are present on the screens.
